manager_agent_note: Generated from local artifacts and subagent read-only investigations. Secrets from runtime config are intentionally omitted.

latest_run.filename: Dolbeault和Rein - 1999 - Time-dependent rescalings and Lyapunov functionals for the Vlasov-Poisson and Euler-Poisson systems,.pdf

notes: Server stayed shut down; fixes were implemented and verified with local test commands only.
Raw TeX is no longer treated as a pre-render blocking error; renderer/browser diagnostics now own raw-TeX rendered versus unrendered status.
The latest translated PDF artifact was not regenerated in this pass.

root_causes.title: Inline candidate detector accepts prose, address fragments, and prose-adjacent math spans
root_causes.internal_reason: Inline detection trusts font/math-signal heuristics and the validator requires only one math signal for short formulas, so non-formula spans such as address fragments or glued prose become formula candidates.
fix_plan: Add explicit inline guards for postal-code/address patterns, alphabetic hyphen labels, math glued to English words, and punctuation-only tails.
Use nearby text boundaries when evaluating inline candidates so a span like infinity+and is rejected before recognition.
Add tests for D-80333, x-variable, infinity+and, and short real inline formulas such as d >= 3.

root_causes.title: Formula validators do not count common LaTeX comparison and infinity commands as math signals
root_causes.internal_reason: Normalization converts <=/>=/infinity to commands such as \le, \ge, and \infty, but both validator regexes omit those commands. Short formulas like d \ge 3 and \le 0 therefore have zero counted signals and are rejected or fall back to plaintext.
fix_plan: Add \le, \ge, \ne, \approx, \infty, \to, \pm, \Delta, and common relation commands to both backend and renderer math-signal patterns.
Treat short relation formulas as valid when they contain a variable/number on each side of a relation operator.
Add backend and renderer tests for d \ge 2, h \ge 1, \le 0, and 2 dx \le C.

root_causes.title: Display cluster promotion and text truncation split or merge formulas with prose
root_causes.internal_reason: Display clusters are built from nearby formula-like fragments, then normalized with language-boundary truncation. In this run that produced candidates whose LaTeX collapsed to t, (i), for (VP) or, or prose-merged long equations.
fix_plan: Record cluster member spans and truncation decisions in rejected records so the bad segment can be repaired deterministically.
Prefer visual OCR/image fallback for display clusters when truncation removes most of the source text.
Add fixtures for the observed Vlasov-Poisson clusters around pages 5, 6, 11, 15, 17, 20, and 29.

root_causes.title: Text-layer normalization leaves PDF math glyph corruption and pseudo-LaTeX unresolved
root_causes.internal_reason: The symbol map and repair rules miss glyphs and constructs seen in this paper, including △, xi/eta variants, barred h, Z/IR standing in for integral/real-space notation, compact partial derivatives, and decimal equation numbers.
fix_plan: Expand glyph normalization and corruption detection for triangle delta, Greek variants, barred/dotted variables, real-space/integral degradation, and equation numbers like (1.1).
Normalize compact partial derivative tokens before validation, but keep the original source text in diagnostics.
Add regression examples from formulas p0002_formula_15cbbb442ad4, p0011_formula_661dc3dbed3d, p0021_formula_d8345f5eafa7, and p0030_formula_bacece2b6a46.

root_causes.title: Visual OCR is attempted too little and falls back to deterministic text without enough diagnostics
root_causes.internal_reason: The run used active OCR providers minimax_vision and deterministic; pix2text was not active. MiniMax failed or timed out on most visual attempts, then the service hit the visual-candidate cap and accepted deterministic/text-layer fallbacks with low-confidence flags.
fix_plan: Separate status fields for visual OCR failed, visual OCR skipped by cap, deterministic fallback accepted, and text-layer fallback after visual failure.
Report active provider order separately from installed provider availability, without implying pix2text was used.
Make the visual-candidate cap configurable per run and include it in diagnostics.
Add OCR-service tests for timeout, invalid JSON, and max-visual-candidate fallback behavior.

root_causes.title: Rejected promoted clusters leave stale legacy F... formulas and refs alive
root_causes.internal_reason: Legacy DocumentIR formulas are promoted to canonical pNNNN_formula candidates. When the promoted replacement is rejected, _attach_formulas removes only accepted legacy replacements, so stale F... refs remain in DocumentIR, chunks, and plans while recognition diagnostics count only accepted replacements.
fix_plan: Define an explicit rejected-promoted-cluster policy: retain with legacy_formula_retained_after_rejection, replace with image fallback, or demote to source text.
Add diagnostics for document_formula_count, accepted_formula_count, legacy_retained_count, stale_formula_ref_count, and unknown_formula_ref_count.
Extend layout-plan validation to require formula refs to resolve to known DocumentIR formulas or declared fallback aliases.

root_causes.title: Renderer rejects KaTeX-renderable formulas as corrupt before trying KaTeX
root_causes.internal_reason: The renderer corruption heuristic treats \partial followed by multi-letter text, and patterns like x0I, as unrepaired corruption. Valid compact derivatives such as \partial xU and \partial tf are rejected before the KaTeX renderer is called.
fix_plan: Narrow or remove the \partial\s+[A-Za-z]{2,} corruption heuristic in renderer validation.
Try KaTeX before falling back when delimiter balance is valid, and only mark corruption if KaTeX fails or stricter evidence exists.
Add renderer tests that \partial tf, \partial xU, \partial tu, \partial tF, and \partial tw render without fallback.

root_causes.title: Malformed legacy LaTeX survives validation and fails KaTeX in the final PDF
root_causes.internal_reason: _latex_looks_renderable only checks delimiter balance. A legacy formula containing undefined \B passes that check, then both Python KaTeX and browser KaTeX fail and the PDF keeps plaintext fallback.
fix_plan: Use the existing KaTeX wrapper as the renderability check for formulas that are otherwise considered valid.
Add safe repairs for common set-difference or blackboard-bold mistakes, or force image fallback when unsupported commands remain.
Add a regression test for the Feb8fd4c3395b / p0012_formula_6815172edba2 shape.

root_causes.title: Image fallback formulas render tiny and can use dirty or partial crops
root_causes.internal_reason: Image fallback spans omit data-latex so browser retry cannot repair them. The template applies one max-height rule to all fallback images, including display equations, and upstream crops may contain neighboring prose or only a formula tail.
fix_plan: Add display-specific image fallback CSS that uses available block width/height instead of inline 1.8em sizing.
Keep data-latex on image fallback spans when a plausible LaTeX string exists so browser retry can replace the image if possible.
Flag partial/dirty crops using crop coverage and source text length; do not silently present them as complete formulas.
Add visual/HTML tests for display formula image fallback sizing and alt text.

root_causes.title: Translator/layout plan can introduce unknown formula refs that renderer only catches late
root_causes.internal_reason: The plan validator preserves token strings but does not verify formula IDs against DocumentIR.formulas. The renderer therefore emits formula-unresolved plaintext for invented IDs such as p0019_b4450dbe2c466_inline.
fix_plan: Validate every {{formula:id}} in TranslationChunk and TranslationLayoutPlan against DocumentIR.formulas before render.
Repair common invented inline IDs by mapping them to the nearest source preserve token only when unambiguous; otherwise fail the chunk with a clear diagnostic.
Add tests for unknown formula refs in plan blocks and inline_items.

root_causes.title: Raw TeX emitted by translation is escaped as normal text instead of rendered or rejected
root_causes.internal_reason: Renderer formula handling only recognizes {{formula:...}} and legacy @@FORMULA...@@ placeholders. If the translator emits $...$ or backslash math directly in translated_text, the renderer escapes it as visible text.
fix_plan: Add post-translation validation that rejects raw TeX outside formula placeholders unless explicitly allowed.
Repair simple raw TeX spans into formula refs or inline formula HTML only when they map to known preserve tokens.
Add diagnostics raw_tex_unrendered and tests using $t\geq 0$, \mathbb{R}, and -\partial\xiW examples.

root_causes.title: Last browser-measured height override is not rendered once more
root_causes.internal_reason: render_preview_with_browser_layout measures and applies overrides inside the iteration loop. If the final allowed iteration still discovers a new overflow override, the function exits without one final rebuild that uses it.
fix_plan: After the last measurement, if overrides changed, rebuild RenderDocument/html once with the final measured overrides before returning.
Add a renderer test where overflows reduce across iterations but one remains at max_iterations.

implementation_plan.title: Tighten formula identity and diagnostics before changing rendering behavior
changes: Add known-formula-ref validation helpers for DocumentIR, TranslationChunk, and TranslationLayoutPlan.
Add diagnostics for accepted, rejected, stale legacy, unknown, raw TeX, visual OCR failed, and visual OCR skipped formula counts.
Preserve deterministic local fallback but make every fallback explicit in job artifacts.

implementation_plan.title: Repair recognition and normalization shared causes
changes: Add inline false-positive guards and relation-command math-signal support.
Expand text-layer normalization for glyphs and compact derivatives seen in the latest run.
Define rejected promoted-cluster behavior so stale F... refs cannot silently masquerade as current formulas.
Improve visual OCR diagnostics and provider-order reporting without exposing keys.

implementation_plan.title: Fix renderer fallback semantics and final browser validation
changes: Narrow renderer corruption heuristics and rely on KaTeX probe for balanced formulas.
Add display image fallback sizing and preserve data-latex where retry is possible.
Collect post-browser formula diagnostics so Python fallback counts do not disagree with final PDF state.
Rebuild once after final browser-measured overflow overrides.

implementation_plan.title: End-to-end acceptance on the latest paper
changes: Rerun the latest document with deterministic and configured visual OCR paths.
Assert no unresolved formula placeholders, no visible raw TeX, no tiny display image fallbacks, and no browser block overflows.
Keep the server stopped unless an explicit end-to-end rerun is requested.

acceptance_criteria: The same latest PDF run produces zero unresolved_formula_placeholder cases.
Known short relation formulas such as d >= 3, h >= 1, and <= 0 are either recognized/rendered or deliberately classified as prose with clear evidence.
Renderer post-browser diagnostics report no remaining plaintext/image formula fallback except explicitly accepted image-only formulas with usable display sizing.
No translated_text contains raw $...$ or backslash math outside formula placeholders unless flagged raw_tex_unrendered and blocked from accepted output.
Formula diagnostics expose accepted, rejected, stale legacy, unknown ref, visual OCR failed/skipped, and deterministic fallback counts without leaking API keys.
Browser validation passes with zero block overflow for the affected formula-bearing pages.
